quickStart.title: Read an existing Redis string
quickStart.description: Connect to a local Redis server and look up one string key. This example does not write to Redis.
quickStart.note: Replace `user:1` with a string key in your instance. The result depends on the stored value. Use the authentication guidance for servers that require credentials.

introduction.title: Use values from Redis alongside analytical data
paragraphs: Redis stores values under keys and supports structures such as hashes and lists. This extension accesses those values from DuckDB, so a SQL query can look up operational data and combine it with local tables.

Use it for inspecting a Redis instance or enriching rows with values already held there. You need a reachable Redis server and the appropriate credentials. Reads observe that server’s current data; save the results locally when you need a repeatable analytical snapshot.
